answer: PostSeal mails a sealed one-time code to every seat's registered street address, and the seat must return it signed within ten days before its first payout clears. The penalty trigger is a returned-to-sender envelope: any seat whose code comes back undeliverable forfeits its thirty POA bond and escrow. A hundred rented mailboxes cost five dollars each monthly plus postage, so a thousand fakes need a thousand real doors and the bill grows by five dollars per extra seat, a slope no onyx pool of cloud accounts flattens and no glacier outwaits, while the paper trail piles along each ridge.
